explanation: I searched Mathlib's MinimalPrime files and grepped for minimalPrimes together with radical. Mathlib has IsLocalization.AtPrime.radical_map_of_mem_minimalPrimes, which proves the opposite implication: q ∈ I.minimalPrimes gives (I.map).radical = q.map. It has no converse statement. The converse needs IsLocalization.minimalPrimes_map, Ideal.radical_minimalPrimes and Ideal.under_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime, plus several steps of glue. That is more than a one- or two-line derivation.
